jobs.title: Lab engineer
jobs.description:
Annapurna Labs, an Amazon company, designs and delivers high-end, custom silicon that sits at the very heart of AWS. Our devices don't just support the cloud - they actively define it. From Trainium, the purpose-built machine learning accelerator driving the next wave of AI innovation forward, to Graviton, the Arm-based server processor that is redefining price-performance for compute workloads, to Nitro, the advanced network and cloud management controller that powers every single AWS instance - Annapurna's products consistently set the standard for the entire industry

jobs.title: Hardware Technical Program Manager, Nitro Team
jobs.description:
Annapurna Labs is the team behind the custom silicon and systems at the heart of AWS (Amazon Web Services) infrastructure — we operate like a start-up with the scale of the world's largest cloud provider.



Key job responsibilities
Per K2 Generation, own tasks that are cross cards SKUs. This includes:
- Drive shared technologies (Ethernet, PCIe, DRAM) integration plan. Work w partner Org in AWS (eg NPD, AIS, HW-Eng) on per generation plan with milestones. This while getting definitions from K2 owner, and Ethernet, PCIe and DRAM owners.
- Own Readiness to new Chip
jobs.basic_qualifications:
- At least 5 years of Program Management; Managing multi-discpline hardware (or HW+SW) based programs (one/or-more of: Post-silicon, system products). Leading tasks of 5+ teams deliveries. Experience with 2+ full cycles of Program Management from kickoff to Mass-Production.
- Hardware experience (at least 5 years) in one of the System Development disciplines: board design or mechanical or QnR or other HW discipline.
- Experience with owning multi-discipline task forces with direct customer impact.
- B.Sc. in Engineering.
jobs.preferred_qualifications:
- Experience with Mass Production
- Experience with either: PCIe add-in cards or Mezz cards design or architecture; Servers (x86 / ARM / Machine learning) design or architecture; Silicon Program Management
- Experience w leading execution of new methodology/product-flows
- Experience w direct work with customer (customer interface management, leading support)
- Experience with presenting status summary to senior leadership (beyond the direct manager)
